name: HYDRA-UMC-SDK
build: Functional JSON Schema v1 contracts, plus real, tested Python, Go, TypeScript and Rust reference clients and conformance fixtures.
notes: The common contract and conformance boundary for services, UIs, CM5 adapters and URTC. Provides v1 JSON Schema, a Python reference validator and conformance fixtures, plus a real, automatic compatibility matrix (tools/verify_contract_matrix.py) between the published schemas and the validator - found and fixed a real gap where the ProjectManifest (hydra-umc.project.json) contract had no validator entry at all. Go, TypeScript and Rust reference clients (clients/go, clients/typescript, clients/rust) now compile and enforce the real published schemas directly through a real Draft 2020-12 validator library per language, each with its own passing test suite against the shared conformance fixtures; the CI baseline now actually discovers and exercises all three (their manifests live under clients/, not the repository root). Package publication remains a release gate.
